ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels constitute approximately 85% of the visible surface area; low-intensity black pixels constitute approximately 15%, localized primarily to the distal tips and the trailing edge boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid high-intensity white central mass spanning both lobes. Continuous low-intensity black perimeter along the trailing edge and lobe tips. Discrete, low-intensity punctate spots (specks) scattered across the ventral surface, with a higher concentration on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; peaks exhibit pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 12 pixels, particularly pronounced on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edges, sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of three distinct circular high-contrast rings (dark outlines with light centers) located near the vertical axis and lower-right lobe; several smaller circular pixel clusters on the medial-left section.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of 5-7 parallel, dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically/diagonally on the lower-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular barnacle attachment scars near the center-right; multiple linear rake marks on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Large, diffused, low-contrast grey circular patch (pigmentation anomaly) located on the distal region of the right lobe.
